title: Encryption, Plainly
hook: Encryption scrambles data with a key.
narration: Encryption scrambles data with a key.
HTTPS is that scramble in your browser.
Without the key, the message looks like noise.
That is why cafe wifi is less scary than it used to be. Still, do not bank on sketchy pages.
